name: zanker-performance-audit
description: Check UI media cost, font behavior, interactions and layout instability.

workflow.instruction: Inventory fonts, videos and images that contribute to first paint.
Review intrinsic image sizing, lazy loading and layout shift risk.
Measure real Web Vitals with suitable field tooling where available; avoid inferring LCP/INP from screenshots.
Provide prioritized fixes with estimated UX impact.

fallback: Use source-level resource review and document no field data.
